verdict.rationale: ZCode has a plugin system with install/update, a page API and host-integration entry points, shown with an Excalidraw canvas example (zcode-gh-6). Its site also claims support for 20+ coding tools including Claude Code (zcode-docs-5), which suggests third-party agents can be brought into ZCode workflows. However, neither source explicitly describes partner-built agent apps or how they are integrated. Missing for 10: an explicit partner/third-party agent app ecosystem or marketplace, documentation on how external agents plug into workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of such integrations.
